gravedad (Ley 17/2011: leve / grave / mu: Food Code category: Core / Priority foundation / Priority (never "severity" in the column header)
guía de inspección de Sanidad: health inspection self-checklist / readiness guide (UK: Food Hygiene Rating Scheme 0-5)
carnet de manipulador: food handler card (state/county) + CFPM (Certified Food Protection Manager); UK: no legal certificate, Level 2 usual
regeneración: reheating (Reheat for hot holding, 165 °F within 2 h)
enfriamiento rápido: two-stage cooling (135 to 70 °F in 2 h, to 41 °F in 6 h)
Temp a las 2 h / a las 6 h: Temp at 2 h / Temp at 6 h
descongelación controlada: controlled thawing (refrigerator, covered, on a tray)
anisakis / congelación preventiva: parasite destruction (freezing): -4 °F for 168 h or -31 °F for 15 h; UK/EU 24 h at -4 °F (-20 °C)
hielo fundente / ebullición: ice point (32 °F) / boiling point (212 °F minus elevation/550)
altitud: elevation (feet above sea level); example: Denver, 5,280 ft, about 202 °F
alerta alimentaria (protocolo): food recall & foodborne illness response plan
autoridad sanitaria / Salud Pública: local or state health department (UK: local authority and the FSA)
